title: Daily questions: free-form count input + updated reminder for ≥1 streak rule

requirements.summary: Replace the 5-checkbox daily tracker with a numeric input that saves any non-negative question count (blank treated as 0) via the existing updateTodayProblems mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: The DailyTracker component provides a numeric entry for “questions solved today” rather than 5 fixed checkboxes.
If the user clears the input and submits/saves, the app sends 0 to updateTodayProblems.
If the user enters a number (including >5) and submits/saves, the app sends that number to updateTodayProblems and the UI reflects the saved value after mutation success.
All user-facing labels/messages related to this control are in English.

file_operations.description: Replace the checkbox-based selection (fixed 0–5) with a controlled numeric input and an explicit Save action. Treat blank input as 0; validate to a non-negative integer before calling useUpdateTodayProblems (send BigInt(value)). Update all tracker copy to remove the “Goal: 5 problems” framing and ensure all labels/messages are English. Keep UI composed from existing components (e.g., Card/Button) and/or a native input; do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Update reminder logic and copy to remove “complete 5 problems” framing and trigger only when today’s logged questions are 0.
acceptanceCriteria: DailyReminder no longer calculates “problems left to complete 5”.
DailyReminder triggers only when stats.todayProblems is 0 (and not dismissed for the day).
Reminder text is updated to English copy consistent with the new rule (at least 1 question keeps streak; 0 breaks streak and applies a 20 rupees fine).

file_operations.description: Change reminder trigger condition to show only when stats.todayProblems equals 0 (respecting the existing per-day dismissal). Remove all calculations and UI copy referencing “5 problems” or “problems left”. Update the English reminder message to reflect: solving at least 1 question keeps/increases streak; solving 0 breaks streak and incurs a flat ₹20 fine.
